title: The PROBLEM With Buy Now Pay Later
summary: Personal-finance video walks through a Klarna checkout example to argue people should generally avoid BNPL except for necessities.

assertions.quote: all these plans stretch out your payments to make something seem more affordable
buy now pay later can be the perfect trap for people to spend money on items they might not actually need
it's also been found that these payment services help to increase conversions

verdicts.note: Matches Stripe's and providers' own conversion-rate data showing gains across price tiers, not just on larger purchases.

NBER: BNPL significantly increases merchant profitability despite its cost, primarily through more shoppers completing a purchase (conversion lift dominates the sales increase by a factor of 2-3 over higher per-customer spending).

CFPB documents the merchant-facing value proposition (conversion and average-order-value lift) lenders use to justify their fees, without comparing BNPL's merchant fee rate to standard card processing fees.

assertions.quote: using buy now pay later is an okay option at least in the short term

verdicts.note: Widely echoed by consumer advocates (e.g., Bankrate) as the lower-risk use case for BNPL.
